title: Epic Pinball physics trace contract (EP1)
description: Shared contract between the emulator harness (tools/emu/run_scenario.py, which runs the original EP1.EXE code) and the Swift port. A scenario file drives a run; the output is JSON Lines, one 'record' per physics step, 3 per frame. Frame f = the main-loop work of frame f (lane/plunger logic, then gravity: vy += p_gravity if vy <= 320) followed by 3 physics steps (EP1 cs:1724, which ends with flipper_update cs:3CDD). Inputs for frame f are applied before the main-loop work and held for its 3 steps. See docs/formats/emulation.md.

ball.description: Ball slot 0, raw values of the original's DS words (all signed 16-bit).

x.description: ball_x ds:6A46: integer pixel x of the TOP-LEFT of the 15x14 ball box, table coordinates 0..319

y.description: ball_y ds:6A52: integer pixel y of the top-left, 0..399 (drain at y >= 399 = 0x18F; collision is skipped while y >= 384)

xf.description: ball_accx ds:6A18: sub-pixel accumulator, 1/128 px. Usually -127..127, but can hold up to +-2000 of backlog when the 5 px/step cap applies

vx.description: ball_vx ds:6A00: velocity in 1/128 px per physics step

vy.description: ball_vy ds:6A0C: velocity in 1/128 px per physics step, positive = down

layer.description: Scenario only (optional, default 0): ball_layer ds:6772, 1 = upper level (ramps), colours BC..C7 collide, reflection divisors + p_up_*

active.description: Scenario only (optional, default 1): ball_active. 0 = slot 0 starts inactive (EP8: its launch code only runs while no ball is active)

params.description: Optional overrides of the 10-word parameter block at ds:6781, either by name or as a 10-element list (null = keep). Defaults come from the user's EP1.EXE (EP1: 17 17 8 4 5 2 4 3 3 4).

up_y.description: ds:678F added to rest_y on layer 1

up_x.description: ds:6791 added to rest_x on layer 1

table.description: Table 1..13. The harness takes each table's addresses from tools/emu/tables/EPn.json (tools/emu/discover.py). EP1 cs:/ds: addresses quoted in this schema differ per table

inputs.description: Per-frame bitmask: 1 = left flipper held, 2 = right flipper held, 4 = plunger held. Frames past the end of the list are 0. The harness pokes cs:028D (left), cs:028F (right), cs:0297 (Ctrl = plunger) as the int 9 handler would.

on_drain.description: stop: the trace ends before the first frame that starts with ball y >= 0x18F. continue: the game's own drain/serve code runs (ball re-served at (284,336), vx=vy=0, accumulators NOT cleared, serve_delay=7 frames during which the plunger is ignored).

mode.description: Harness only. physics: main-loop physics pieces only (no sensor/rule dispatch). rules: also ball_pixel_scan (cs:1679 -> rule handlers). full: the whole real main loop body cs:04D2..1243.

pokes.description: Harness only: raw writes to named DS variables of tools/emu/ep_emu.py before frame 0 (e.g. kicker_cooldown).

balls.description: Optional: balls for slots 1..4 in order (slot 0 = ball). Read by the harness and the Swift port.

extra_balls.description: Harness only: balls for explicit slot numbers, e.g. {"slot": 2, "x": .., "y": ..}.

ball.description: State of ball 0 after this physics step (after push-out and the flipper update)

collided.description: collided_this_step ds:6C59 after the step: at least one collision response ran in this step (any ball)

k.description: Contact direction of the FIRST collision response of ball 0 in this step (the one that changes velocity), as stored in ds:586E: 1..48, probe numbering of collision.md (1 = east, 13 = north, 25 = west, 37 = south, counter-clockwise). The normal / push-out table entry used is k-1. null if ball 0 had no response in this step.

left_flipper_pos.description: lflip_angle ds:6CD2 after the step: 9 = rest, 0 = fully up

extra.description: Optional diagnostics (harness writes them; consumers may ignore).

responses.description: number of collision_response calls for ball 0 in this step (1 velocity response + push-out iterations)

k_all.description: k of every response (push-out iteration) for ball 0, in order

flipper_contact.description: ds:6768 at the first response: 0, 1 = left moving flipper, 2 = right

kick.description: kick_strength ds:676C at the first response (kicker hit), else 0

loop_guard.description: Swift port only, written only in a step where it happens: the push-out loop hit the port's iteration guard. The original has no cap and never returns from physics_step in such a step (it hangs), so the harness trace ends there. tools/emu/diff_traces.py treats this key as a diagnostic, not a compared field.

divide_faults.description: Swift port only, as loop_guard: number of idiv overflows in this step (a divide error on a real CPU; the harness stops).
